rules: One resolved numeric series; preserve entity and dimension selection; no interaction operators.
Observation-count windows and lags; regular cadence gaps reject unless explicitly preserved as missing slots; irregular series ordered by declared observations.
PIT computations reselect source state at each evaluation cutoff. Release events require explicit generic anchor and revision capabilities; historical release shocks use earlier emitted changes.
Complete required windows, no imputation or adaptive shortening. Seasonal prior-bucket filtering and capped streaks are explicit documented exceptions.
Exponential alpha=1-exp(log(0.5)/h), first-value seeding, h consecutive valid observations to emit; missing or invalid arithmetic resets the state; EW standardization estimates moments through t-1.
Sample SD uses n-1; descriptive zero SD is valid. Standardization and variance ratios with zero denominators are undefined.
Quantiles use type-7 linear interpolation; percentile ranks use strict-less plus half ties; skewness and kurtosis use declared sample-SD moment formulas inherited from legacy.
No NaN/infinity valid result; missing input, arithmetic domain failure and insufficient history are distinct controlled outcomes. Unexpected execution exceptions remain visible.
Output semantics and units follow the registered operator rules; counts are observation counts; fractional returns are not multiplied by100; log-level outputs retain explicit log-unit annotation.
Legacy grid membership never overrides mathematical validity; enumeration is explicitly requested and bounded. Weekly zscore156 extension has its own immutable policy identity.

Regular Gregorian cadence means daily=one calendar day, weekly=seven calendar days and intraday=positive interval_seconds with UTC timestamp precision. Monthly, quarterly, semiannual and annual cadence uses strict one/three/six/twelve month strides, preserving day of month or both month ends; business calendars, resampling and filling are not inferred.

An absent regular period rejects under either supported gap policy unless the input explicitly contains a null observation slot for that period. Native input ordering is reference_time; emitted intermediates are event series ordered by evaluation_cutoff.

For emitted history, the first recipe stage resolves native state independently at each own explicitly declared release anchor. Subsequent stages consume the emitted history with event frequency. Native release operators are allowed only as the first stage and require the exact requested reference anchor; an absent anchor is invalid and simultaneous ambiguous availability anchors reject.

Derived result available_at equals its evaluation_cutoff under this retrospective computation policy; execution time is provenance only and never historical availability. Float64 is the explicit numerical boundary; nonfinite arithmetic yields controlled invalid outcomes, and successful outputs are canonical decimal strings.
Externally supplied derived roots are rejected until an explicit SourceView binds the upstream recipe. Composition of compatible intermediate envelopes inside one declared recipe is implemented.
title: Approved transformation engineering policies, version 2.0.0
